description: This Java class `StatusTracker` manages activity status states within an Android lifecycle, tracking activity names and their statuses with methods to set, get, and clear states, along with maintaining a method call history.

classes.name: StatusTracker
classes.description: Singleton class that tracks the status of activities and maintains a list of method calls related to activity statuses.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status for a given activity name and records the method call.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the modified status string for a given activity name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored activity statuses and method call history.

methods.name: getMethodList
methods.description: Returns the list of method calls related to activity status updates.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of activity names tracked.
